scope: Every concrete model is events-owned; tenant path is event.makerspace_id, or snapshot.submission.event.makerspace_id for reference rows, or submission.event.makerspace_id for snapshots/links, or snapshot.submission.event.makerspace_id for integrity flags. Work resolves exactly one typed asset.event.makerspace_id.

models.HackathonSubmission: Private tenant source; preserve historical state on portable import, close operational editing through imported config, clear public_requested and public_asset_ids. Clone copies no rows.
models.SubmissionSnapshot: Immutable private historical source. Preserve sequence/hash and source_content_sha256; schema-remap IDs with portability.remap_snapshot, recompute canonical target hash only while materializing a new imported row. Never update existing history.
models.SubmissionLink: Private source, retained when snapshot-referenced. Current draft version selected by submission.links_version. Reset operational public_requested on import; snapshot copies remain private historical evidence.
models.SubmissionIntegrityFlag: Private historical source. Preserve informational flags/review history; disable automatic remote polling on import. No eligibility writer.
models.SnapshotAsset: Immutable typed reference to exactly the same submission/team/event ready asset. Private evidence; reset operational public disclosure on import.
models.SnapshotLink: Immutable typed link/value reference to same submission. Frozen normalized URL/provider are source; no unfurl, embed or recursive text rewriting.
models.SnapshotTrack: Immutable typed same-event D track reference. Remap track FK explicitly.
models.SnapshotPrize: Immutable typed same-event D prize reference. Remap prize FK explicitly.
models.SubmissionAsset: Retained metadata/hash/expiry and ready unexpired owned canonical bytes. No incomplete upload/session state travels. All metadata stays private except a live D gallery projection.
models.HackathonParticipantAsset: Private member-owned event resume, independently owned from P vault. Same byte retention; never gallery/public. D consent is sole sponsor authority and resets revoked on portable import.
models.EventAssetUsage: Event-owned pool/retention anchors. Preserve first-results/fallback/cancellation absolute anchors; rebuild counters and target allowance from retained ownership. Never import managed entitlement.
models.SubmissionAssetWork: Omit coordination at both tenant fidelities; DROP on portable import. Deployment resets lease token/until and reconstructs cleanup from retained asset locators; never lose deletion obligations. saved_asset_id/saved_detail_version are account-vault coordination references, excluded from all tenant closure.

json_id_slots.exclusions: form_answers, descriptions, declarations, URLs and user text are never scanned for IDs

purge: G collects every final/staging/verification object version and multipart locator before graph deletion. Delete D/E dependents first, clear HackathonSubmission.current_snapshot, remove immutable reference children under app.allow_immutable_delete, delete amendment snapshots newest-first (self PROTECT), then assets/links/projects/work/usage before A teams. Event-only purge cannot delete P vault or global organizations.
